assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Clinical Symptoms
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: What signs or symptoms did you experience during the course of your illness?
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Fever Rash Enlarged Lymph Nodes Pruritis (itching) Rectal Pain Rectal Bleeding Pus or blood on stools Proctitis Tenesmus/urgency to defecate Headache Malaise (general feeling of illness or weakness) Conjunctivitis Abdominal Pain Vomiting or Nausea Myalgia (muscle aches) Chills
